title: Snake
description: A pixel snake game: arrow keys to move, a score, pause/resume, restart and a game-over screen. Start paused and show how to play.

title: Pomodoro timer
description: A pixel pomodoro timer: 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes, start/pause/reset buttons and a big countdown.

title: Tip calculator
description: A pixel tip calculator: bill amount, tip percent buttons (10, 15, 20) and the number of people; show the tip and the total per person.

title: Pixel pet
description: A pixel virtual pet: a CSS-drawn creature with hunger, happiness and energy bars; Feed, Play and Sleep buttons change the bars, and its mood text updates.

title: Memory match
description: A pixel memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards: flip two at a time, matched pairs stay open, count moves, show a win message and a New game button.

title: Palette generator
description: A pixel color palette generator: show 5 color swatches with their hex codes, a Generate button for a new harmonious palette, and a lock toggle on each swatch to keep it.
